messages:
elena (Partnerships): BlueWave SI reported staging -> customer A (gov-region) private deploy failing. GPUs briefly show then disappear, app crashes. Need arch + field eng to triage. @devon @martin

aj (Solutions): Which image/version + runtime? Was this on Dedicated or Private? Any regression vs last week?

devon (Field Eng): Private VPC deploy. Image: rw-inference:v1.12 (marketplace). Runtime: containerd 1.6, nvidia-container-toolkit present. Symptoms: kernel oops 'nvidia: failed to register GPU' and then device disappears. dmesg snippet:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: GPU at PCI:0000:3b:00: GPU is lost
[ 1234.570001] nvidia: probe of 0000:3b:00 failed with error -12
```

martin (Eng-Platform): Could be driver/nvidia-container mismatch. What driver version and host kernel? Also are they using `--gpus` or device plugin?

devon (Field Eng): Host kernel 5.15.0-101, NVIDIA driver 525. Output of `nvidia-smi` before crash:
```
NVIDIA-SMI 525.85.12 Driver Version: 525.85.12 CUDA Version: 11.8
```
We saw `modprobe: module nvidia not found` right after crash.

aj (Solutions): BlueWave says they used a custom marketplace image that bundles libcudnn different from our curated images. Could be ABI mismatch.

sam (Security): Any KMS/HSM involvement? Could this be image signature causing image to be re-pulled while modules loaded? Need to rule out image rotation.

elena (Partnerships): Customer is in gov-region with image attestation enabled, but BlueWave confirmed they didn't rotate image during window. @ops-oncall-bot can you pull the deploy logs and node agent traces?

ops-oncall-bot: Collected logs: https://internal-log/1756001111. Found repeated `OOM` on `containerd-shim` 10:23:45 UTC. Node shows transient NIC reset same timeframe.

martin (Eng-Platform): NIC reset + GPU lost suggests PCI bus resets — could be firmware or kernel driver. Any recent host firmware updates? @bluewave-si (not in channel) please confirm.

devon (Field Eng): Immediate mitigation: schedule canary on Dedicated with curated image rw-inference:v1.11 (known good), and enable `device-plugin` instead of `--gpus`. Recommend setting node taint and draining nodes after business hours.

aj (Solutions): I'll coordinate canary and field visit. @elena please loop in BlueWave PM and request their marketplace image build recipe and container runtime config.

elena (Partnerships): On it. I'll start an arch review with BlueWave tomorrow 10am PT and tag infra eng for firmware checks. :rotating_light:

martin (Eng-Platform): Also open ticket for firmware validation & ask infra to capture `pci-states` and BIOS logs.

devon (Field Eng): If we need rapid workaround, we can enforce `nvidia-drm.modeset=1` kernel param and pin driver 525.85.12. Not ideal but buys time.

aj (Solutions): Noted. I'll set follow-up in calendar and update the customer. :thumbsup:
